2. Who can use the App

You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. You may add family members you care for, such as a parent, spouse, or child, as described in section 4.

3. Your account

4. Family members

You may add family members and book care or use the App's tools for them. By adding someone, you confirm that you have their permission, or that you are their parent or legal guardian if they are a child or cannot decide for themselves. You are responsible for the information you enter about them.

5. What the App provides

The App lets you book home care services and use wellness tools in four areas:

  1. Nutrition: BMI and body measurements, Meal Scanner, health self-assessments, and diet guidance.
  2. Exercise: mobility training, physiotherapy, and therapeutic exercise services.
  3. Bio Markers: vital monitoring (such as blood pressure, sugar, and oxygen), Lab Report Insights, and health records noted by our care staff.
  4. Mind & Wellbeing: wellbeing and psychological support, spiritual care, and relaxation care.

We may add, change, suspend, or remove features at any time. Features marked "Coming soon" or "Beta" may be incomplete.

6. Not medical advice

  • The App's tools are for general wellness. The App is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
  • Scores, AI estimates, and suggestions in the App are for information only. They do not replace advice from a qualified doctor, dietitian, physiotherapist, or mental health professional.
  • Always consult a qualified professional before changing your diet, exercise, medicines, or supplements. Never ignore or delay professional advice because of something in the App.
  • The App is not for emergencies. In a medical emergency, call 108 (ambulance) or 112, or go to the nearest hospital. For mental health support, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, 24×7).

7. Bookings, care visits, and fees

  • The App is free to download and use.
  • Home care services booked through the App are paid. Our team will confirm the date and time with you and tell you the charges, usually after the visit. You pay our care staff directly. We will always tell you the charges before you pay.
  • Care visits are delivered by our care staff or partner professionals. Your treating doctor remains responsible for your diagnosis and treatment.
  • Please give us as much notice as possible if you need to cancel or reschedule a visit.
